scope: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual, time-based candles and footprints
binary_note: Release binary built from the final production implementation. Subsequent edits were cfg(test) regressions, the replay example, and documentation.
focused_regressions: Later price rejection and opposing aggressive flow are required for confirmation
Continuation cancels observations; confirmed failure remains visible
A revisit more than five minutes later cannot reclassify a previous reaction
Execution gaps, explicit disconnects and overflowing seconds reset warm-up
Base and quote quantity conventions produce the same notional
Tape, price bands and event collections remain bounded
Old persisted configurations deserialize with defaults; unsafe numeric settings are normalized
Unsupported sources cannot enter the Binance detector
Four hours plus warm-up are requested with stable retry bounds
Partial history is not published and historical overlap replaces the live tape once
Queued live batches after replay cannot invert a BTree range or mutate published seconds
Indicator history bypasses the candle raw-trade store; disabled late pages are ignored
Re-enabling the indicator requests fresh history rather than reusing discarded coverage
Renko and TPO do not offer the new indicator

native.execution: Copied release binary in an isolated FLOWSURFACE_DATA_PATH profile, using the existing native iced window
checks: Candle pane: enable from indicator picker, automatic history, live updates and visible historical marks
Readable themed hover evidence with observation and confirmation timestamps
Compact pane settings, default absorption and optional experimental exhaustion
Switch 1m to 5m, zoom and disable/re-enable without losing stream ownership
Persist, close and restart with the selected indicator and configuration retained
Footprint pane: populated executions, available indicator, settings and complete dedicated history
Renko pane: normal bricks; new indicator absent from menu and no orderflow history request
TPO pane: startup and menu gating checked; new indicator absent and no orderflow history request
limits: TPO's unrelated partial historical profile and viewport were not fully qualified
The existing primary app, profile and dirty checkout were not replaced
No trading orders, signing path, or funded-live strategy was exercised
Historical success here used the existing recorder plus the scoped Binance gap-fill path; the entire recorder-disabled four-hour REST download was not separately exercised natively
native.issue_found_and_fixed: Initial native replay/live handoff exposed a reversed BTree range. A shared two-second publication watermark, range guard and immutable published seconds fixed it, with a regression test and subsequent successful native runs.
native.final_candidate_log_scan: No PANIC, FATAL or ERROR entries in the isolated final candle, footprint, Renko and TPO logs

history_loads.pane: Candles, exhaustion enabled for visual inspection
Candles, final default absorption after re-enable

resources.architecture: One-second summaries; no retained raw history and no duplicate UTC-day trade book. Existing connector and subscription de-duplication are reused.
resources.limits_of_measurement: Short sequential snapshots are noisy and include rendering and network work. They show no obvious CPU regression, not a controlled performance guarantee. Compact-byte estimates include approximate tree overhead and are not total process memory. Staging temporarily holds a second compact tape during history loading. Exchange archives may use the existing disk cache.

replay.default_decision: Exhaustion remains optional and experimental after weaker validation; confirmed absorption is enabled by default
replay.qualification: Small selected event study, publication delay included, with fees, slippage and fill quality unmodeled; not proof of a stable edge or profitability

targets.method: Verified file paths, explicit file deletions, then empty directories

cleanup.retained: Source, compact replay and verification receipts, isolated 31 MB release executable, launcher and one profile
cleanup.scope: Only temporary artifacts created in the managed implementation worktree were removed; primary checkout and existing caches untouched
cleanup.review_note: Automatic approval review blocked recursive Remove-Item cleanup commands. Cargo clean and checked individual file deletions succeeded.
